Alphabet is a public company headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States. It was founded in 2015 and trades under the ticker GOOGL. Its website is abc.xyz, and the text drawn from that site identifies it as Alphabet Investor Relations - Home. The company's filings are registered under CIK 0001652044.

The available material does not list any products, MCP servers, or named lawsuits for Alphabet. Its recorded litigation exposure covers 281 matters in California.
